parsed.scene_description: A blurred interior of a modern café or lounge with tiered bookshelves, orange chairs, and patrons seated at tables. A large screen displays a person, and bright lighting contrasts with darker ceiling areas. The motion blur suggests movement during capture.

objects.label: orange chair
objects.observation: An orange plastic chair is in the foreground right, partially obscured by another chair. It has a curved backrest and sits on a polished floor. Its position suggests it's part of a seating arrangement for patrons.

objects.label: bookshelf
objects.observation: A tall, spiral-shaped bookshelf with illuminated shelves occupies the right side. Books are visible on multiple levels. It appears freestanding and extends upward, likely against a wall.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: A person wearing a light-colored shirt is seated at a table on the right. Their face is partially visible. They appear to be interacting with someone or something at the table, possibly eating or drinking.

objects.label: screen
objects.observation: A large rectangular screen is mounted on a wall in the center background. It displays a person’s face, suggesting it might be showing a video or presentation. The screen is framed by purple lighting above.

objects.label: ceiling
objects.observation: The ceiling is dark with recessed lights and structural beams. It slopes downward toward the center, creating a layered effect. Some reflective surfaces suggest metallic or glass elements.
